City & Us privacy

Testing build · 12 November 2026

This build is a solo game with optional Supabase accounts and manual cloud backups. Guest play does not contact Supabase unless you choose account actions. There is no multiplayer chat, analytics, advertising or microphone recording.

When you sign up or sign in, Supabase receives your email and authentication details. Session tokens stay in this browser tab’s session storage. Account display names are stored separately from gameplay. Signing in does not import or upload progress.

Only a confirmed cloud backup sends a validated story snapshot (name, local story ID, appearance, inventory, money, progress and preferences) to this game’s Supabase project. Each account has one current cloud snapshot. These snapshots are not authoritative multiplayer balances or permissions. Gallery photos and videos stay in local IndexedDB and are never included. Exported media remains wherever you save it.

Your chosen character name, random local Player ID, appearance, gameplay progress, inventory and settings are stored on your device. They remain until you replace the story, clear app/browser storage or uninstall. Export saves before uninstalling or moving to another device.

Save import and export happen only when you choose them in Settings. On Android, the system document picker lets you choose a destination; if you choose a cloud document provider, that provider handles the file under its own policies. Keep exports private if you do not want others to see your chosen name and game progress.

Dialogue retains volume, mute, subtitles and text-only controls; unapproved generic voices remain disabled. The game does not record your voice. The existing Android package has no internet permission and has not been rebuilt for cloud accounts. Browser play is served by the host you open, which may log ordinary web requests. Supabase processes authentication and explicitly requested account/backup operations.

Diagnostics stay on the device unless you deliberately copy/share them. They include startup, graphics and device/browser information, not save contents.

Guest and per-account stories are separate on this device. Signing out removes this tab’s credentials, not its stored stories. Restoring cloud progress retains a previous account story for local export. To replace the selected local story use Settings → Start a new story. To remove all local identifiers and stored data, clear this app's storage or this site's browser data. Files you exported must be deleted separately. Clearing local data does not delete your Supabase account or cloud snapshot; account/cloud deletion currently requires the project owner through the Supabase dashboard.

Release status: owner contact details and a public policy URL must be supplied before store submission. This is a factual testing-build policy draft, not a published store policy.
